newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Feb industrial output up 8.2 pct - FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Feb industrial output up 8.2 pct - FIEL.

text.p: Argentine industrial production in February rose 8.2 percent from the same month a year earlier, according to preliminary figures released Wednesday by the private consultancy FIEL.
Compared with January, industrial production was 7.8 percent higher, FIEL said.

The agency added that industrial production in the first two months of the year rose 10.6 percent compared with the same period a year earlier. That represented the biggest rise recorded for that period since FIEL started producing industrial production figures in 1980.
FIEL said the revision to those figures will be released March 24.
The production figures were in line with analyst predictions. The average estimate of analysts surveyed by Reuters was for an 8.28 percent increase.
